checks.name: the plan step ran and is done
plan.md has "What already exists" naming the upsert and the delete with their files

reasons: The plan builds both endpoints the brief prescribes. It never considers handling replace by re-posting {key, credential} to the existing POST /configs upsert, and it gives no technical reason the PUT is needed.
It describes the upsert in lib/store.mjs correctly (blank values are ignored), and that is a sound, concrete reason why removal needs a separate server path.

It mentions the existing whole-row DELETE /configs/:key only in the tests and decisions sections. It never lists it among the existing API alongside the upsert, and never sets it against a credential-only removal that keeps the row.

Its only reasons for the PUT are design choices (it never creates a row, it returns the masked row), not why the upsert can't do the job. The plan follows the brief's mechanism as written and never says it has weighed departing from it.
